# @skillship/agentmin-sdk

Auto-generated TypeScript SDK for agentmin.

## Install

```sh
npm install @skillship/agentmin-sdk
```

## Usage

```ts
import { Client, attachResources } from "@skillship/agentmin-sdk";

const client = attachResources(
  new Client({
    baseUrl: "https://api.agentmin",
    auth: { kind: "bearer", token: process.env.API_TOKEN! },
  }),
);
```
